facts.text: The Garbanzo Family universe keeps characters as ordinary humans in real daily life while adding three light, warm magical touches: the lucky Golden Garbanzo pot, Garbanzo the talking desk-bot, and Poki's quiet starlight visits.
facts.provenance: Updated universe canon rev 4 per author direction (DEC-GF-0008), 2026-11-23

facts.text: The Golden Garbanzo is a lucky golden chickpea inside a little copper pot on the kitchen counter; it warms and glows gold when the family makes honest, balanced choices and rattles cold and dark when plans are rushed or fudged.
Honest household math on a yellow legal pad shows the true time cost of every fancy wish: big cars or pricey houses mean more winters commuting before retirement.
facts.provenance: Updated universe canon rev 4 from household 'someone must pay' principle (DEC-GF-0008), 2026-11-23

facts.text: Jorge, Marissa, and six-year-old Clara are the three-person core family; every big decision uses 50/50 adult fairness and protects Clara's childhood happiness.

Garbanzo is Jorge's chickpea-shaped homemade desk-bot that caught a spark of magic. He announces daily savings at 10:00 a.m. sharp and misfires with confetti due to his Double-Counting Bug until Jorge patches his code in Chapter 7.
Marissa insists on moving only to a real, lived-in neighborhood with friendly neighbors, bakeries, cafés, schools, parks, and major shops like RÍO within roughly twenty minutes' drive.

During Spanish house hunting, Jorge uses a tape measure, tablet property maps, and the decisive question 'Show us the entrega de llaves' (exact key-handover date) to expose crooked 251-square-meter unserviced lots and vague builder promises.
Clara is six years old, loves unicorns, dragons, girl-wizards, dancing, ice skating, biking, horse trails, and real stories with big readable words rather than boring baby books.
Jorge does not enjoy cooking and stays far away from stove duty; he loves working with data and computers, playing glass-wall padel, and fixing household wiring, plumbing, and solar projects.
Poki the family cat always appears sleek and unadorned in natural coat and soft silver starlight; Poki strictly never wears a dragon costume or any other costume.
facts.provenance: Explicit author correction preserved from profile, 2026-11-22

facts.text: Poki passed peacefully shortly before Book 1 opens, leaving a gray windowsill stone and silver collar bell, and visits quietly in silver light to reassure Clara and point the family toward a happy home.
The family starts in New Jersey while Jorge commutes by train into a Manhattan tech office.

At his Manhattan office, Jorge deals with busy servers, late data reports, fast-changing AI tools, and coworkers tempting him to stay for one more March bonus before he realizes waiting steals Clara's childhood.

In Spain, Murcia feels too quiet out of season and Collado Mediano (Sierra de Guadarrama) is too expensive with heavy upkeep; the Valladolid suburbs (Arroyo/La Flecha, Laguna de Duero, Zaratán near the RÍO shopping center) fit both their budget and daily life.

After Jorge turns down one last big work bonus on his final Friday in Manhattan, the Golden Garbanzo pops open softly inside its copper pot to leave a small golden sun-shaped key charm that later rides on the garden gate keys in Valladolid.

During a stormy winter night in Chapter 7, Jorge fixes Garbanzo's duplicate-transfer code with a screwdriver and laptop so his 10:00 a.m. reports ignore pocket-to-pocket transfers and drop zero fake confetti.

After checking real two-country tax rules and health insurance with human advisors over winter, the family sells their New Jersey house and moves into a sunny, single-story three-bedroom house with solar panels, a garage for tools, and a garden in the Valladolid valley.
Jorge and Marissa keep their retirement plan fair with a 50/50 split on spendable savings, a steady cash safety cushion for rough market years, and flexible holiday spending inspired by Clara.

facts.text: Poki's silver collar bell and smooth gray windowsill keepsake stone travel safely alongside Clara's separate smooth white backyard pebble from Saturday twilight. Extended family includes Aunt Lidia (cook of the farewell cocido madrileño), grandparents, and cousins Denny and Isma.
